messages:
Sofia Martinez: Kicking off Medisync POC thread. They're an EMR integrator, want an 8-week eval focused on clinical summarization + redaction. Need scope, success metrics, infra prefs, and security questionnaire owner.
Aaron Kim: Do they require on-prem or private VPC? It affects network setup and timeline.
Priya Rao: Customer said private VPC preferred for PHI; open to hosted if we provide certified controls and explicit KMS binding. Procurement timeline: wants contract by 2025-01-10.
Liam O'Connor: From infra: private VPC + peering will add ~10 business days. If we do hosted with strict KMS + audit logs we can start in 3 days. Which should we propose?
Sofia Martinez: Propose two tracks in SOW: Track A (private peering) = 8-week with +2w contingency, Track B (hosted w/ KMS & DPA) = 8-week nominal. Sales prefers Track B to accelerate.
Aaron Kim: Success criteria draft from customer: 1) Redaction recall >= 0.92 on clinical notes; 2) Summaries pass clinician QA with mean grade >= 4/5; 3) No unredacted PHI in logs; 4) Deployment automation that can hit 50 qps.
Priya Rao: For evals we need 500 de-identified prompts + 100 adversarial privacy tests. Who can generate these?
Aaron Kim: SE team can deliver 500 prompts in 2 weeks, with 100 adversarial cases from security.
Liam O'Connor: Infra ask: baseline dedicated instance = 1x H100-s equivalent pool. If load tests show <50 qps, we can right-size. I can pre-reserve a template but need max seq length and model family.
SE-Bot: DeployBot: provisioning template med-sync-pool created (id: pool-ms-42). ETA provisioning 72h.
Sofia Martinez: Good. SE coverage request: initial ramp 40 hrs/week for first 10 days, then 20 hrs/week thereafter. Aaron, can your team support?
Aaron Kim: Yes, can do 40 hrs/wk for week 0-1, then 20 hrs/wk for rest. We will also provide quickstart scripts and a small SDK sample.
Priya Rao: Pricing ballpark for Track B (hosted + KMS) for 8 weeks: infra ~$9k/week => $72k, SE 20 avg hrs/wk @ $225/hr => 20*8*225=$36k, initial ramp extra 40 hrs * $225 = $9k. Total ~ $117k. Include buffer and professional services wording.
Liam O'Connor: Security checklist: SOC2 link, DPA link, KMS flow diagram, network architecture, retention & deletion policy. I can hand over the KMS diagram. Who will fill the vendor questionnaire?
Sofia Martinez: I'll pair with Priya on the questionnaire. Customer security contact is sec-lead@medisync.com per their initial ask. They expect answers in 3 business days.
Aaron Kim: Evals plan: we'll submit the prompt CSV and golden labels to the shared drive. Proposed eval metrics: redaction recall/precision, summary ROUGE-L and human QA score distribution, 99th percentile latency under 850ms for the hosted track.
Priya Rao: Note on latency SLO: 850ms p99 is acceptable for them given long context. If they require sub-500ms p99, need extra cost for autoscaling and reserved capacity.
Sofia Martinez: Timeline proposal in SOW: Week 0 (contract + security signoff + infra), Week 1-2 (prompt collection + small closed-loop pilots), Week 3-5 (scale tests, QA), Week 6-7 (adversarial privacy tests + integrator soak), Week 8 (final report + handover). Add +2w if private peering required.
Liam O'Connor: Blocker: med-sync IT may insist on cross-account VPC peering which triggers legal & ops review. That could add non-trivial work. Jamie from legal will need to be looped in.
SE-Bot: Reminder: include model family (e.g., vicuna-33b/quant) and max tokens in provisioning form.
Aaron Kim: Action items (SE): 1) produce 500 prompt CSV + 100 adversarial tests (Aaron) 2) create test harness & run 50qps load test (Aaron+Liam) 3) sample SDK & scripted inference examples (Aaron)
Sofia Martinez: Action items (sales/ops): 1) Draft dual-track SOW with Track A/B options and pricing (Sofia) 2) Send security questionnaire draft to sec-lead@medisync.com (Sofia+Priya) 3) Confirm peering requirement today (Sofia)
Liam O'Connor: Action items (infra): 1) Reserve pool template and enable audit logs + KMS binding (Liam) 2) Prepare network impact statement for peering (Liam)
Priya Rao: I'll start filling the questionnaire answers and attach SOC2 + DPA links.
Sofia Martinez: Let's aim to have the SOW + prompt CSV + questionnaire sent by EOD Friday. Meeting to sync Friday 9am PT.
Aaron Kim: Acknowledged. Uploading a sample prompt layout to the drive now.
Liam O'Connor: I'll post the KMS flow and provisioning link once template is live.
SE-Bot: Note: if private peering chosen, set provisioning SLA to medium and expect +10 days.
Priya Rao: Thanks team — will follow up with a summary email after this thread.
Sofia Martinez: Thanks all, will ping legal if peering confirmed.
